institution.name: Data Sciences Institute, University of Toronto

qualifications: Supervisor with a tenure or tenure-stream appointment at U of T, or an eligible PI at a funding partner institution
International applicants must complete the PhD before the start date
Supervisor form, reference letter and demographic surveys due January 29, 2027
Fellowship starts between May 1 and December 1 of the award year
description_short: The University of Toronto's Data Sciences Institute funds one-year postdoctoral fellowships in data science with a U of T or partner supervisor. Candidate proposals are due 22 January 2027 (23:59 ET); supervisor forms and reference letters by 29 January 2027.
